twitter.content: Historical base rates are unforgiving: every prior cycle bottomed 12-13 months after its top. October 2025 peak, ~54% drawdown to ~$58,000 in June 2026, and a mere 31% recovery on falling ETF flows is a dead-cat bounce, not a new uptrend. Base case remains $40k-46k before this epoch ends. The June low will not hold.

IBIT still holds 811,138 BTC ($66.19B, 2026-10-22). The hedge-fund exodus of 2025 was a rotation, not an exit: Q3 2026 inflows rebounded to +$6.3B as advisors, sovereigns and endowments replaced fast money. Durable, sticky allocations are the marginal buyer now — that is the reflation thesis, and it does not require the June low to break.

September 2026 SEP: median funds rate at 4.1% at end-2026 and end-2027, with eight participants seeing hikes. Liquidity conditions remain restrictive; we do not see the macro tailwind crypto markets are pricing. M2 growth of 5.7% is not transmission when the M2-BTC Z-score sits at -1.31.

With CLARITY stalled (Senate cloture failed 49-50 on Sept 15, 2026), the SEC is delivering rules by administrative action: proposed Regulation Crypto Assets (offerings up to $75M per 12 months with safe harbor) and a new adviser-custody rule. We expect finalization in 2027. Legislation is preferred, but regulation will not wait for Congress.

The 119th Congress ends January 2027. CLARITY reconsideration, the BITCOIN Act (1M BTC over five years) and ARMA all face pass-or-lapse decisions within weeks. If reserve purchase authority lapses, the Strategic Bitcoin Reserve stays capitalized-only and legally barred from net-new buying. That binary matters more for 2027 sentiment than any ETF print.

Reminder on the reserve: the March 2025 executive order capitalizes the Strategic Bitcoin Reserve with existing holdings (~328,372 BTC, tracker-based), bars sales, and permits only budget-neutral acquisition. We hold; we do not buy. Also, GENIUS Act stablecoin licensing obligations take effect January 18, 2027 — issuers should be ready.

Composite BTC/USD fixings: Coinbase $81,225.62 (Oct 22), Kraken $81,261 (Oct 23), composite ~$81,243 — roughly 35% below the October 2025 epoch high of $126,080. CME BTCZ27 last traded 89,885, ~8.7% annualized contango. The market is pricing modest recovery; the December 31, 2027 settlement series remains the reference for all price binaries.

Watch the November 2026 and May 2027 13Fs. If top-40 hedge funds keep cutting IBIT (they cut 28% by Q4 2025) while advisors and sovereigns absorb supply, flows reaccelerate. If both cohorts step back simultaneously while STH/LTH churn is at 14.2%, the range breaks down. Flow composition, not headline AUM, resolves the ETF fault line.

Derivatives say this is not a post-cycle collapse yet: 30-day realized vol of 20-23%, VIX 15.78-19.03, and futures contango of 8.7% annualized are inconsistent with late-cycle capitulation. But BTC-equity correlation of 0.5-0.78 means BTC is now a liquidity trade — the 10-year at 4.989% is the real resistance, not on-chain metrics.

Supply-side evidence for the bulls: exchange reserves down to 2.67M BTC, dormant supply growing, LTH re-accumulating after distributing 452,532 BTC in 2025, entity-adjusted NUPL only in the Anxiety/Optimism band. If June's ~$58,000 low holds through June 2027 (12 months past the low), the post-cycle bear case is falsified and the path to six figures reopens.

U.S. Treasury policy statement, December 2026: (1) The Strategic Bitcoin Reserve continues to be administered under the Executive Order of March 6, 2025 — capitalized exclusively with previously forfeited and existing federal holdings, sales prohibited, and any additional acquisition limited to budget-neutral strategies. No taxpayer-funded purchases have been authorized or conducted. Figures circulating regarding the size of federal holdings remain tracker-based estimates and are not confirmed by this Department. (2) Treasury welcomes the SEC's December open meeting to consider adoption of Regulation Crypto Assets and notes the complementary rulemaking required under section 3 of the GENIUS Act (Public Law 119-27): permissible payment stablecoin issuers must be licensed by January 18, 2027, and unlicensed stablecoins are prohibited from being offered to U.S. persons after July 18, 2028. Treasury's proposed rules under the GENIUS Act framework are proceeding on the published schedule, and the public comment record remains open. (3) As stated previously, any expansion of the Reserve beyond existing authorities would require express legislative action by the Congress; pending proposals remain under congressional consideration. Treasury does not comment on market prices.
